title: fix(app-shell): the app-missing screen offers the way home beside Retry
body:
Fixes #13122
Clause-②: no

## What

The console's app-missing branch in `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` (`requestedAppMissing`) draws three verdict screens — `app-not-found` ("This app can't be opened"), `app-unreachable` and `app-not-available`. All three return above the `ConsoleLayout` mount, so they carry no app bar, and they offered only Retry: a stale bookmark or an uninstalled app's link was a full-screen dead end.

Each of the three now draws "Back to home" beside Retry. The button is the access-denied screen's own, factored into one render helper (`renderBackHomeButton`) that both screens call: same copy key (`empty.appAccessDeniedHome`), same navigation (`navigate(homePath)`, the declared home). Test ids follow the existing pattern: `app-not-found-home`, `app-unreachable-home`, `app-not-available-home`. The access-denied screen keeps its `app-access-denied-home` test id and renders the identical button. No new i18n key, no export, no chrome change.

## Pins (in `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished.test.tsx`)

- (a) `the $testId screen offers the way home beside Retry, and it goes home` — one case per verdict: the home button is drawn with the text "Back to home", Retry is drawn beside it, clicking home lands on `/home`.
- (b) CONTROL `Retry on the $testId screen is still drawn and still re-checks` — one case per verdict: clicking Retry calls `refreshMetadata` again and the verdict screen comes back. Written independently of the home button on purpose.
- (b) the access-denied screen is unchanged: the existing cases `the denial screen offers a way back to /home` and the declared-landing case stay green.

## Ablation (one-off, no permanent file)

Fix committed first; mutation through `ablation-replace.mjs` deleting the `renderBackHomeButton(...-home)` line from the missing branch only (anchor 1 to 0, blob 9343ae560f74 to bcd2e851e811), trap-guarded restore:

- mutated: `Tests  3 failed | 22 passed (25)` — exactly the three (a) cases red; the three Retry CONTROLs and the denied-screen home case green.
- restored: blob after restore == HEAD blob `9343ae560f748d669af602aed68ce6e9649104b2`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- green on HEAD `ada1ba4e01`: `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  25 passed (25)`.

- Targeted vitest on the edited test file, `--maxWorkers=1`: 25/25. Declared narrowing: this one-file, one-worker run (and the ablation) ran outside the shared lock after about 30 minutes queued behind a sibling full-directory run.

Population read from the root `eslint.config.js`; `--format json` counted 2 files; that config enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService` / `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file.
